title: Bilateral 4-kHz audiogram curvature does not establish incremental HbA1c prediction across two NHANES samples
abstract: Bilateral 4-kHz audiometric curvature did not establish incremental HbA1c prediction across NHANES samples: target weighted MSE gain -0.00074735 percentage-point-squared units; joint source-refit/target PSU-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.00559748, 0.00096714]. Development used 1,751 adults in 2001–2002, and evaluation used 1,667 separately sampled adults in 2003–2004. A fixed linear curvature term was compared with flexible demographic, BMI and conventional hearing-summary models. This is an exploratory negative representation test with temporal within-program validation, not equivalence or external clinical validation.
